events.body:
## Context

CONTRIBUTING clones `github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/OWASP-Wich.git`; README says `cd OWASP-Wich`. `requirements.txt` lists PyYAML and python-dotenv, which aren't imported. `.env.example` documents `GITHUB_TOKEN` in a `.env`, but nothing calls `load_dotenv`.

## What to do

1. Use `cd BLT/blt-owasp-wich`.
2. Remove PyYAML; either load `.env` in `main()` or drop python-dotenv and make `.env.example` an `export` hint.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Setup steps work verbatim
- [ ] Requirements match the imports
- [ ] `.env` behaviour matches the docs

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m venv /tmp/w && . /tmp/w/bin/activate && pip install -r blt-owasp-wich/requirements.txt
```

---
